# AI SDK documentation

> The TypeScript toolkit for building AI applications and agents.

## When to use AI SDK

- Category: Developer tools
- Audience: JavaScript and TypeScript developers

> For an index of all documentation, see [/llms.txt](/llms.txt).

This page focuses on understanding back-pressure and cancellation when working with streams.

## Back-pressure and Cancellation with Streams

Let's begin by setting up a simple example program:

```jsx
async function* integers() {
  let i = 1;
  while (true) {
    yield i++;
  }
}
```

Depending on the type of application you're building, you may want to cache the responses you receive from your AI provider.

## Using Language Model Middleware

Use `wrapLanguageModel` with a caching middleware to cache `doGenerate` results.
